reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact intervention (0.8 wt.% Cu@Gr, SPS conditions), mechanism (enhanced Cu network, inhibited carbide formation, activated sintering), and predicted outcome (~24% thermal conductivity improvement) from P5, P6, and P8, applying them to the same W-Cu composite system. The only new element is the proposed falsification test with irradiation and thermal cycling, but the core scientific idea is a verbatim copy of the earlier reported results.
